_readme: Prices from LG Roofing Material official price list, July 2026, with an added house markup: main roof shingles +$1/bundle (+$3/SQ), Hip & Ridge +$1/bundle, Starter +$5/bundle, Underlayment +$5/unit, Leak Barrier +$5/unit, Add Ons +$2/unit, Flashing Accessories/Drip Edge/Valley Flashing Metal +20%, Roofing Coil Nails +$5/box, over list price. All other categories are list price, no markup. All prices include TX sales tax already. Coverage figures sourced from manufacturer spec sheets where possible -- see 'confidence' field on each item. 'assumed' = no official spec exists for this exact use or box size; derived using standard industry convention, NOT yet confirmed against a physical bundle/box. 'confirm-sku' = confirmed number exists but two roll/box size variants are sold under this name, verify which one LG stocks. Treat 'assumed' and 'confirm-sku' items as provisional until checked.
